note: Platform catalogue for Explore. Dates are relative to the account's today (startsInDays / endsInDays) so every demo story stays coherent. 'listing' is 'verified' when the organiser is verified by DeepSprout, 'demo' for sample content.

listings.title: Beyond Reels
listings.summary: A six-week digital-balance initiative: an opening survey, two talks, a workshop and an optional outdoor day.
objectives: Understand what a feed is designed to do
Build one week that holds without it
Meet people working on the same thing
listings.eligibility: Ages 16–26 · open to anyone in Jordan
listings.commitment: Joining adds you to the initiative’s updates and its opening survey. It does NOT book any talk, workshop or trip — each part has its own registration, capacity and date.

components.title: Opening talk: what a feed is designed to do
Workshop: building a week that holds

listings.title: Start Today
listings.summary: A procrastination-awareness initiative: a short survey, one webinar and an optional five-day challenge.
objectives: Notice where the first hour of the day goes
Try one small starting ritual
Share what worked with others
listings.commitment: Joining adds you to the initiative and its survey. The webinar and the challenge each ask you separately. This initiative does not change your Roadmap or your results.

components.title: Webinar: starting is the hard part

listings.title: What attention actually is
listings.summary: A 45-minute talk on how attention works, what research supports — and what it does not.
objectives: Separate attention myths from evidence
Leave with one thing to try this week
listings.commitment: Your place is held for the live session. The link appears on your registration an hour before. Opening the link is not attending — the host confirms attendance.

listings.title: Workshop: a phone you actually chose
listings.summary: A two-hour, hands-on workshop on setting up a phone so it stops making decisions for you.
objectives: Rebuild your home screen around what you meant to do
Set limits you will actually keep
listings.commitment: This workshop is full. Joining the waiting list holds no place yet: if a place opens, you are offered it and have 24 hours to accept.

listings.title: For families: talking about screens without a fight
listings.summary: An evening for parents and teenagers together, run by a family counsellor.
objectives: Agree one rule together
Practise a conversation that does not start with blame
listings.commitment: Your place is for one family. Join in person or online — the organiser confirms attendance on the day.

listings.title: Ajloun forest day
listings.summary: A guided day in the Ajloun reserve: a slow trail, lunch outdoors, no phones on the path.
objectives: Walk a 7 km guided trail
Spend a full day without the feed
Meet others from the initiative
listings.commitment: Your request goes to the organiser, who confirms places within 3 days. It is not a booking until it is confirmed. Attending is not completing — the guide signs off completion on the day.

listings.title: Sunrise walk and breakfast
listings.summary: An early walk to a viewpoint, then breakfast together before the day starts.
objectives: Start one day without a screen
A short, easy walk with a guide
listings.eligibility: All ages with an adult · easy walking
listings.commitment: This experience is full. The waiting list holds no place yet: if one opens you are offered it in order and have 24 hours to accept.

listings.title: Three-day reset camp
listings.summary: Three days in the Dana reserve with workshops, long walks and evenings around a fire.
objectives: Three full days away from the feed
Daily reflection sessions
Return with a plan for the week after
listings.commitment: Your request goes to the organiser, who confirms within 5 days and sends the kit list. Each camp session has its own attendance record.

listings.title: Make something in a week
listings.summary: Make one real thing away from a screen in seven days — a drawing, a meal, a repaired bike — and share how it went.
objectives: Finish one small project
Submit a photo and a few lines
Judged on care, not polish
listings.commitment: Entering means submitting one entry before the deadline. Judges and criteria are named on the brief. Entering is not winning, and taking part earns nothing on its own.
